note: Both sets are accurate on the shared claims: the 15–30C transformation range, the strain/transition-temperature relationship, the 250 louvers cut on a 3-Axis-CNC mill, the 32 aluminum rods, the threaded connection at the actuator base, and the no-additional-energy behavior are all correctly bound and quoted. Set A additionally captures two supported facts B omits: the pulley-assembly parts being ABS (via 3D printing) and the large hysteresis period slowing the rotational closure of the louver. Neither set contains misread or invented claims, so A wins on completeness rather than correctness.
